notes.title: General Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Long overdue patch for stats not registering properly for achievements and leaderboards, also a few smaller issues like falling larvae collision and angry worker VFX not showing up sometimes.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Tested them to the best of my ability, there could still be some issues so please let me know on the discussion board.

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.notes:
2 new maps to play over the festive period!
An alternate universe hive where you must fill the cells before winter ends and a hive with a built in maze to get lost in!
